title: Made possible by the community
mission: This launcher is for people who just want to play, without having to understand command lines, engine builds or compatibility fixes.
credit: Years of work by engine developers, mod teams and open-source maintainers make these games work on modern systems. C&C Unix Launcher brings their work together and guides you through setup. The engines, mods and compatibility tools belong to their creators.
tooltip: Years of community work make this possible. I help make setup easier for everyday players. I plan to share part of the support I receive with upstream maintainers and record those donations publicly. Open Community & donations for credits and the ledger.
donationPolicy: Support on Ko-fi helps me maintain this launcher. From time to time, I plan to donate part of that support to upstream maintainers. There is no fixed percentage or schedule; each donation will be recorded after it is made.
ledgerDetail: This is a manually maintained record of onward donations, not a live Ko-fi balance. The bundled ledger reflects this release; the public ledger may be newer.
emptyLedger: No onward donations have been recorded yet.
